title: Overview
text: Overview SampleStatKit is a small MoonBit statistics package used to demonstrate MoonDocKit adoption outside the main repository documentation. The package author keeps three ordinary inputs: handwritten usage notes release notes a generated `.mbti` interface MoonDocKit turns those files into a browsable documentation site with search, navigation, API reference output, and a machine-readable site manifest. Why This Case Matters This example proves the workflow is not tied to MoonDocKit's own source pages. The same CLI can document a separate package shape with its own title, metadata, routes, and API symbols.

title: Changelog
text: Changelog 0.1.0 Added summary statistics helpers. Published generated API documentation from `pkg.generated.mbti`. Added MoonDocKit quality checks before release.

title: Quick Start
text:
Quick Start Install the package, prepare a sample, and call the statistics helpers. let values = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0]
let report = @sample_statkit.summarize(values) The generated API page lists `mean`, `median`, `percentile`, and `summarize` from the package interface. This lets users move from a short guide to exact MoonBit declarations without searching the source tree. Release Gate Before publishing docs, the package maintainer runs: moon info
moon run --target js cmd/moondockit --config examples/adoption-package/moondockit.json --strict Strict mode turns broken documentation into a release-blocking signal.
